```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("scratch_viz.R"); source("scratch_report.R")
library(ggplot2); library(data.table); library(crosstalk); library(plotly); library(htmltools)

D <- readRDS("demo.rds"); qc <- as.data.table(D$qc); cells <- as.data.table(D$cells)
LIN <- scratch_lock_levels(sort(unique(cells$lineage)), key = "lineage")
THR <- list(min_cells = 500, min_genes = 900, max_mito = 20, max_doublet = 8)

qc[, status := fifelse(n_cells < THR$min_cells | median_genes < THR$min_genes*0.6, "critical",
              fifelse(median_genes < THR$min_genes | pct_mito > THR$max_mito |
                      doublet_rate > THR$max_doublet, "warning", "good"))]
qc[, reason := trimws(gsub("\\s+"," ", paste(
    fifelse(n_cells < THR$min_cells,"too few cells",""), fifelse(median_genes < THR$min_genes,"low complexity",""),
    fifelse(pct_mito > THR$max_mito,"high mito",""), fifelse(doublet_rate > THR$max_doublet,"high doublets",""))))]
nc <- qc[status=="critical",.N]; nw <- qc[status=="warning",.N]; ng <- qc[status=="good",.N]
```

```{r findings, include=FALSE}
if (nw) scratch_register("qc_warn","warning", sprintf("%d samples pass with caveats", nw),
  paste(qc[status=="warning", sprintf("**%s** (%s)", sample, reason)], collapse="; "), stage="qc", value=nw)
csf <- qc[csf==TRUE]
if (nrow(csf)) scratch_register("qc_csf","info",
  sprintf("CSF samples carry %.0f%% fewer cells than resections",
          100*(1-mean(csf$n_cells)/mean(qc[csf==FALSE]$n_cells))),
  "Expected for low-cellularity aspirates; thresholds are per sample, not cohort-wide.", stage="qc")
scratch_register("qc_pass","good", sprintf("%d of %d samples pass unmodified", ng, nrow(qc)), stage="qc", value=ng)
scratch_findings_json("data/findings.json", stage="qc")
```

## Verdict

```{r verdict, results='asis'}
scratch_section(
  "Every sample scored against the QC thresholds, before any figure.",
  how  = "Each chip is one sample; the glyph and label carry the verdict, so it reads without relying on colour.",
  watch= "Any **critical** sample is excluded before the merge — its cells never reach downstream stages.")
scratch_verdict(setNames(qc$status, qc$sample), labels=qc$sample)
scratch_tiles(list(
  Samples=list(value=nrow(qc), sub=sprintf("%d pass · %d warn · %d fail", ng,nw,nc),
               state=if(nc)"critical" else if(nw)"warning" else "good"),
  Cells=list(value=format(sum(qc$n_cells),big.mark=","), sub="before filtering"),
  Retained=list(value=format(sum(qc[status!="critical"]$n_cells),big.mark=","), sub="entering merge"),
  `Median genes`=list(value=round(median(qc$median_genes)), sub="per cell"),
  `Mito %`=list(value=sprintf("%.1f%%", median(qc$pct_mito)), sub="cohort median")))
scratch_headline()
```

## Per-cell distributions

```{r explain1, results='asis'}
scratch_section(
  "Genes detected against mitochondrial content, one point per cell, coloured by lineage.",
  how  = "Use the **sample** dropdown to filter. Select several to overlay them. Hover any point for its exact values. Dashed lines mark the thresholds.",
  watch= "A cloud pushed left (low complexity) or up (high mito) is a dying or ambient-contaminated population. Lineages should separate; heavy overlap suggests the annotation is unreliable.")
```

```{r cells-linked}
cv <- cells[, .SD[sample(.N, min(.N, 420))], by=sample]          # hover layer only
cv[, id := .I]
cv[, hover := sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>lineage: %s<br>genes: %s<br>mito: %.1f%%",
                      sample, lineage, format(genes, big.mark=","), mito)]
sd_cells <- SharedData$new(as.data.frame(cv), key = ~id, group = "qc")

p_cells <- plot_ly(sd_cells, x=~genes, y=~mito, color=~lineage, colors=LIN,
                   type="scatter", mode="markers",
                   marker=list(size=5, opacity=.65),
                   hovertext=~hover, hovertemplate="%{hovertext}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis=list(title="genes detected"), yaxis=list(title="mitochondrial %"),
         hovermode="closest", legend=list(orientation="v", x=1.02),
         shapes=list(
           list(type="line", x0=THR$min_genes, x1=THR$min_genes, y0=0, y1=1, yref="paper",
                line=list(dash="dash", color="#d03b3b", width=1)),
           list(type="line", x0=0, x1=1, xref="paper", y0=THR$max_mito, y1=THR$max_mito,
                line=list(dash="dash", color="#d03b3b", width=1)))) |>
  config(displaylogo=FALSE, toImageButtonOptions=list(format="svg", scale=2))

bscols(widths=c(3,9),
  list(filter_select("f_sample", "Sample", sd_cells, ~sample, multiple=TRUE),
       filter_select("f_lin", "Lineage", sd_cells, ~lineage, multiple=TRUE)),
  p_cells)
```

## QC metrics across the cohort

```{r explain2, results='asis'}
scratch_section(
  "Every QC metric for every sample, on a shared scale per panel.",
  how  = "Hover a bar for the exact value, the cohort median, and how far the sample sits from it. Bar colour repeats the verdict above.",
  watch= "A sample that is an outlier on **one** metric is usually recoverable; one that is extreme on several is not.")
```

```{r metrics-bars}
m <- melt(qc[, .(sample,status,n_cells,median_genes,median_umi,pct_mito,doublet_rate)],
          id.vars=c("sample","status"), variable.name="metric")
m[, med := median(value), by=metric][, dev := value - med]
m[, hover := sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: <b>%s</b><br>cohort median %s (%+.1f)",
                     sample, metric, format(round(value,1), big.mark=","),
                     format(round(med,1), big.mark=","), dev)]
STAT <- c(good="#0ca30c", warning="#fab219", critical="#d03b3b")

# One panel per metric, shared y so samples line up across panels.
subplot(lapply(levels(m$metric), function(v) {
  d <- m[metric==v]
  plot_ly(d, x=~value, y=~reorder(sample,value), color=~status, colors=STAT,
          type="bar", orientation="h", showlegend=(v==levels(m$metric)[1]),
          hovertext=~hover, hovertemplate="%{hovertext}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(annotations=list(list(text=v, x=0.5, y=1.04, xref="paper", yref="paper",
                                 showarrow=FALSE, font=list(size=11))))
}), nrows=1, shareY=TRUE, titleX=FALSE) |>
  layout(hovermode="closest", legend=list(orientation="h", y=-0.12)) |>
  config(displaylogo=FALSE)
```

## Composition

```{r explain3, results='asis'}
scratch_section(
  "Share of each lineage per sample, using the same colour map as every figure above.",
  how  = "Hover a segment for its cell count and percentage. The dropdown filters both this and the scatter above.",
  watch= "CSF aspirates should be immune-dominated; a resection that looks immune-dominated may have lost its tumour compartment during dissociation.")
```

```{r comp}
comp <- cells[, .N, by=.(sample,lineage)][, frac := N/sum(N), by=sample]
comp[, hover := sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s<br>%s cells — %.1f%%",
                        sample, lineage, format(N, big.mark=","), 100*frac)]
plot_ly(comp, x=~sample, y=~frac, color=~lineage, colors=LIN, type="bar",
        hovertext=~hover, hovertemplate="%{hovertext}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(barmode="stack", yaxis=list(title="share of cells", tickformat=".0%"),
         xaxis=list(title="", tickangle=-35), hovermode="closest") |>
  config(displaylogo=FALSE)
```

## Ask

```{r explain4, results='asis'}
scratch_section(
  "A question box that answers from this report's own data — no network required.",
  how  = "Ask in plain language. Every number is computed live from the embedded tables, so it cannot disagree with the figures above.",
  watch= "If a local model is serving on this machine it phrases the answer; the numbers still come from the computation, never from the model.")
```

```{r agent, results='asis'}
scratch_agent(tables=list(
    qc_metrics=qc[, .(sample,cohort,status,reason,n_cells,median_genes,median_umi,pct_mito,doublet_rate)],
    composition=comp[, .(sample,lineage,cells=N,percent=round(100*frac,1))]),
  stage="qc", project="GBM/OV/PDAC cohort", viz_dir=".")
```
